title: The Calla
subtitle: A single D-flawless pear, opening on a ring of marquise petals. From the Bloom Collection.

stone.origin: Natural. GIA certified. Set in platinum, oriented along the line of the finger. Marquise-cut diamond petal ring beneath the centre.

description: A single pear diamond stands at the centre in platinum, oriented along the line of the finger so its point leads the eye. Beneath it, a ring of marquise-cut diamonds opens like petals around the pavilion, passing fire upward into the centre stone from below — the flower not set on top of the diamond but built to feed it light. It is the clearest statement of the Bloom Collection: structure borrowed from nature, engineered so the bloom serves the stone.
